subjects.name: Death and cover-up of Pat Tillman

summary: After NFL player turned Army Ranger Pat Tillman was killed by friendly fire in Afghanistan in 2004, Army commanders and the Bush administration hid how he died and used his death as war propaganda.

evidence.note: Tillman decides to enlist in the months after 9/11; earlier NFL years only sketched briefly
long segment on the staged rescue of Jessica Lynch in Iraq in 2003
Lynch rescue PR run from CENTCOM headquarters in Qatar
April 2004 Afghanistan deployment and the split-platoon ambush
McChrystal orders the cause of death concealed; Silver Star citation follows
White House and reelection staff rush out a statement on his death
July 2008 congressional oversight report closes the investigations
2017 Trump retweet tying Tillman to the NFL anthem dispute; legacy co-option

notes: Primary subject set to the death and cover-up event, not Tillman himself: the episode frames him as a good man and the bastards as those around his death, and his pre-army life gets only a few minutes. If reviewers prefer Tillman as primary, the lifetime rule would push covered_span back to 1976.
